text: Hard hitting fact, would be interesting to have it compared to previous years, how did that change after the pandemic? Highly relevent!
Clear & precise formulation of the research question
Schedule seems realistic & has a good structure
Ethical considerations are definitly relevant and mentioning them shows a awareness for potential problems

This seems like a possible Bias to me or I am not understanding this part correctly. 
Should the AR headsets be lended from friends and given to other people or should the subject group consist of personal acquintances? Either way: Sourcing participants or material from personal contacts seems like a potential bias (either for the testing group or the devices used) to me and should be considered carefully.
How will the interview take place? IMO psychical considerations need to be taken into account aswell. The paper mentions mental health as an issue but how this will be evaluated is missing here

Methodology could be a bit clearer since its not entirely clear what will happen during the experiments and interviews. It is difficult to grasp how valid and reliable the information gathered will be without expanding on the methodology used.
could there be qualitative losses by using publicly available sources?

Accessibility is not only limited to physically getting access to the devices but also how easy to use the devices are. Would be interesting to know how this problem will be tackled to help all users with using & understanding the technology
